chunks: A clan from the Ansar came to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and greeted him, and he returned their greeting. They said, “O Messenger of Allah, we have a need to ask of you.” He said, “Present your need.” They said, “It is a great need.” He said, “Say what it is.” They said, “Will you guarantee Paradise for us with your Lord?”
So he صلى الله عليه وآله lowered his head and traced in the ground. Then he raised his head and said, “I shall do that for you on condition that you do not ask anyone for anything.”

It was said: a man among them would be on a journey and his whip would fall, yet he would dislike saying to anyone, “Hand it to me,” out of avoidance of asking; so he would dismount and take it himself. And he would be at the dining spread, while some of those seated were nearer than him to the water, yet he would not say, “Pass it to me,” until he himself stood and drank.

key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: the Helpers of Madinah who supported the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the promised reward in the hereafter
key_terms.الْمَسْأَلَةِ: asking from people, seeking something from them
key_terms.حَاجَةٌ: a need or request being presented
key_terms.فَخِذٌ: a clan or sub-tribe from a larger group
key_terms.لَا تَسْأَلُوا: do not ask; refrain from requesting things from others

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله require from the Ansar in return for guaranteeing Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches self-restraint and dignity through refraining from asking people for things, even in small matters. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله linked this trait to the promise of Paradise, and the Ansar then practiced it with great seriousness in daily life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1758 - A group from the Ansar came to the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) and greeted him with peace. He returned their greeting and said, "What is your need?"
They replied: "We have a significant request of you."
He said: "Tell me your request."
They said: "We ask that you guarantee us Paradise from your Lord (azj)."
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) lowered his head and began to draw in the ground. Then he raised his head and said: "I will grant you this on the condition that you do not ask anyone for anything."
It was said that after this, one of them would be on a journey, and if his whip fell, he would not ask anyone to hand it to him but would dismount and pick it up himself to avoid asking. Similarly, when they were seated at a table, if someone closer to the water could pass it, they would not request it but instead stand up and take it themselves.
